mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_favorite ( user_id, post_id, create_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{postId}, NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT fp.id AS postId, fp.user_id AS userId, fp.title, fp.content, DATE_FORMAT(fp.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, fp.like_count AS likeCount, fp.collect_count AS collectCount, ui.name AS publisherName, ui.avatar AS publisherAvatar FROM post_favorite pf JOIN forum_post fp ON pf.post_id = fp.id JOIN user_info ui ON fp.user_id = ui.id WHERE pf.user_id = #{userId} AND pf.is_deleted = 0 AND fp.is_deleted = 0 AND ui.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pf.create_time DESC
